params.query:
# radar-backtest cordis_sparql dataset=organisation_types page
PREFIX eurio: <http://data.europa.eu/s66#>
SELECT (REPLACE(STR(?org), "^.*/", "") AS ?org_id) (REPLACE(STR(?t), "^.*[#/]", "") AS ?type)
WHERE {
  ?org a eurio:Organisation ; a ?t . FILTER(?t != eurio:Organisation)
}
ORDER BY ?org ?t
LIMIT 10000 OFFSET 10000
